**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The licence grant is § 4(c) (p0021): a royalty-free, non-exclusive, **perpetual** licence to Contractor's Information embedded in the Works, expressly **including the right to grant sublicences**, for use, copying, modification, derivative works and display "in connection with Company's business operations." § 4(d) (p0022) reinforces it by letting us make changes or engage others to do so, without further payment.

Why this meets the playbook:
- **Not revocable at will** — perpetual, with no revocation right reserved to RadialSpark; none of the walk-away features are present.
- **Affiliates and contractors** — the unrestricted sublicence right gives us a no-notice, no-consent path to cover affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, which is at or above the preferred position (the fallback only requires affiliates on written notice).
- Non-exclusivity is normal and appropriate for a vendor's background IP.

Noted, not flagged (minor sub-elements per classification rules):
- The grant does not use the word "irrevocable," though perpetuity plus the absence of any revocation trigger achieves the same result.
- Successor transfer runs through the mutual assignment clause (p0042), which requires consent "not unreasonably withheld" rather than an express M&A-successor carve-out. That mechanic belongs to the assignment rule, so it is not double-flagged here.
